1. **BaseLoader Enhancement**:

2. **Supported All Loader Types**:
   - Updated [`FileSystemLoader`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-jg21tgf8/repo/src/jinja2/loaders.py#L189-L215) to accept `path_transform` and apply the transformation prior to splitting template path segments.
   - Updated [`PackageLoader`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-jg21tgf8/repo/src/jinja2/loaders.py#L282-L350) to accept `path_transform` and apply the transformation prior to splitting template path segments.
   - Updated [`DictLoader`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-jg21tgf8/repo/src/jinja2/loaders.py#L422-L440) to accept `path_transform` and apply the transformation before dictionary lookup.
   - Updated [`FunctionLoader`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-jg21tgf8/repo/src/jinja2/loaders.py#L461-L485) to accept `path_transform` and pass transformed template names to `load_func`.
   - Updated [`PrefixLoader`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-jg21tgf8/repo/src/jinja2/loaders.py#L506-L525) to accept `path_transform` and transform the template path before splitting by delimiter into prefix and child name.
